Third-party libraries served from Rbooked itself (no outside CDN), used only by the menu importer in the dashboard:
- pdfjs/ — PDF.js 3.11.174 (Apache-2.0), reads text from PDF menus
- tesseract/ — Tesseract.js 5.1.1 + core + English data (Apache-2.0), reads text from menu photos
- xlsx/ — SheetJS Community 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0), reads Excel files
